apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk, sideload it
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

## What's new
- iOS: translate the RetroArch Slang Shaders messages
- iOS: say when a shader preset fails to compile
- iOS: show the right sliders when presets are picked quickly
- iOS: retry a shader preset that failed to load
- iOS: say why a shader preset can't load
- iOS: download RetroArch Slang Shaders from Install Shader Pack
- iOS: tidy the shader code and shorten its comments
- iOS: share one set of helpers across the iOS source tests
- libretro: report valid geometry without Vulkan
- libretro: fix compilation without vulkan
- Take whichever hardware context the frontend has, rather than one or none
- Ask for a GL context that can run the renderer
- Touch: take the scale from the digitizer, and gate on either axis
- Pad: default the device-haptic fallback on for handhelds
- GS/HW: Treat an unaligned 8 pixel shuffle strip as not a shuffle
- GS/HW: only exempt a mode 5 sprite whose near edge is on a whole pixel
- GS/HW: don't push a mode 5 sprite that starts on a whole pixel
- GS/HW: give line rectangles half a device pixel of offset in every HPO mode
- GS/HW: draw lines over exactly the pixels the GS lights
- GS: don't auto-flush the alpha stencil counter on the hardware renderer
- GS/HW: draw the alpha stencil counter with dual-source blending
- GS/VK: decide the fast stencil shadow road per device
- GameDB overlay: restore the readback-mode overrides
- GS: remove the Tekken 5 MediaTek Mali half-pixel-offset hack
- GameDB: bring GameIndex.yaml back to upstream PCSX2
- GameDB overlay: keep only overrides with a reason on today's JIT and renderer
- iOS: install the Rust iOS target so CI builds keep shaders
- GS/SW: one coordinate grain per primitive, and the gradient on a grid under it
- GS/SW: the coordinate's sixteenth truncates toward zero, into a signed 12.4 field
- GS/SW: a UV-route sprite's ascending ramp seeds a sixteenth of a texel low
- GS/SW: one floor per pixel in the colour walk, and two write-path defects
- GS/SW: the console's logarithm is a 128-entry table, so read the table
- GS/SW: the affine texture coordinate walks in a 12.15 accumulator
- GS/SW: fourteen bits of reciprocal, and divide at the vertex only where affine
- GS/SW: the measured colour interpolator -- block grid, anchor, row pairs, fog
- GS/SW: seed each span at its own left edge, and drop the gradient to ten bits
- GS: the auto-flush split follows the engine's level, not the hardware key
- GS: TEX1.K is already signed, so stop sign-extending it a second time

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260915...4cbd36beccd723fbf850569cd321fe827d72bbd2
